archived.title: Archived
archived.description: True to archive, false to restore.

path.title: Path
path.description: Relative to the run folder, with / separators.

groups.description: Groups as a dataset build would assign them (SPEC §9.2).

final.title: Final
final.description: True once training chose it; otherwise the best so far.

supported.title: Supported
supported.description: A file type FlipTuned can read.

parent.title: Parent
parent.description: Parent folder, if it's also inside an allowed folder.

base.title: Base
base.description: The base model instead of the fine-tuned one.

first_difference.title: First Difference
first_difference.description: Character where the answers first differ.

key.title: Key
key.description: Dotted path in the effective config, e.g. training.learning_rate.

stage.title: Stage
stage.description: The verdict this criterion gives when it isn't met.

kept_exports.title: Kept Exports
kept_exports.description: Exports outside the app home, left in place.

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: Only the first N test items.

status.title: Status
status.description: queued, running, ready (answers generated; review and score), failed, cancelled or interrupted.

merge.title: Merge
merge.description: Also build a merged standalone model.

result.description: Ready now when no merge was asked for.

job.description: The merge job, when a merge was asked for.

grouped_records.title: Grouped Records
grouped_records.description: qa_pair records in a group of two or more.

largest_group_share.title: Largest Group Share
largest_group_share.description: Share of all qa_pair records in the largest group.

precisions.title: Precisions
precisions.description: Precisions this option accepts here ('auto' first).

target_modules.title: Target Modules
target_modules.description: Which layers get LoRA adapters (NVIDIA/CPU). 'auto' picks them for the model architecture.

cpu_max_params_b.title: Cpu Max Params B
cpu_max_params_b.description: Largest model, in billions of parameters, allowed to train on CPU. CPU training is very slow.

config.title: Config
config.description: An ingest config; source paths must be allowed.

result.title: Result
result.description: The job's result, once it succeeded.

error.title: Error
error.description: message / hint / details, if it failed.

by_status.title: By Status
by_status.description: Effective status counts of matching records.

emulated.title: Emulated
emulated.description: Python runs under Rosetta or x64-on-ARM emulation.

pool.title: Pool
pool.description: VRAM, unified memory or RAM, after the run's device.

peak_gb.title: Peak Gb
peak_gb.description: Peak use reported by the training job.

total_gb.title: Total Gb
total_gb.description: Size of that pool on the machine it ran on.

turns.title: Turns
turns.description: The conversation: alternating user/assistant turns ending with a user turn.

num_layers.title: Num Layers
num_layers.description: How many of the model's last layers get LoRA adapters (Apple Silicon). -1 means all.

backend.title: Backend
backend.description: 'hf_peft' or 'mlx'. Empty = the backend auto would use here.

estimate_note.title: Estimate Note
estimate_note.default: Memory figures are catalog estimates of peak training memory at default settings, not measurements of this machine.

backends_here.title: Backends Here
backends_here.description: Backends on this machine with a version of it.

cached.title: Cached
cached.description: Model files for the selected backend are downloaded.

download_gb.title: Download Gb
download_gb.description: Download size for the selected backend.

PreflightContext.title: PreflightContext
PreflightContext.description: What training needs once preflight passed (internal; not shown to users).

model.title: Model
model.description: Catalog ID whose tokenizer counted the tokens.

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: Source IDs or names; empty = all.

flag.title: Flag
flag.description: A quality flag name, or 'privacy' for any privacy finding.

only_duplicates.title: Only Duplicates
only_duplicates.description: Only records whose question appears more than once.

include_source_blocks.title: Include Source Blocks
include_source_blocks.description: Also list source blocks (they never train).

privacy_findings.title: Privacy Findings
privacy_findings.description: Finding types; values are never included.

text.title: Text
text.description: Source blocks only; privacy findings redacted.

reference.title: Reference
reference.description: The approved answer from the dataset.

judgement.title: Judgement
judgement.description: The current judgement, if reviewed already.

ReviewPair.title: ReviewPair
ReviewPair.description: One blind pair. Only "A" and "B": which model wrote which stays on the server.

pair.description: None when every pair has been reviewed.

external_exports.title: External Exports
external_exports.description: Exports written outside the run folder.

attempts.title: Attempts
attempts.description: Training jobs of this run, oldest first.

offset.title: Offset
offset.description: Byte offset into the latest attempt's events (SSE ID).

last_seq.title: Last Seq
last_seq.description: Last event seq read from the latest attempt.

eta_s.title: Eta S
eta_s.description: Seconds left at the last report.

log.title: Log
log.description: The last 300 event lines, oldest first.

result.title: Result
result.description: Training result summary, once an attempt ended.

resume_note.title: Resume Note
resume_note.description: Why Resume isn't possible, if it isn't.

lock_holder.description: Another job holding the model lock (blocks Resume and new runs).

config.title: Config
config.description: A training config; saved as its name's next version.

created.title: Created
created.description: False when an identical latest version was reused.

name.title: Name
name.description: Data source name. Defaults to the folder name.

skipped_files.title: Skipped Files
skipped_files.description: Hidden files and Office lock files.

text_files.title: Text Files
text_files.description: Markdown and TXT files (paths relative to root).

regressions.title: Regressions
regressions.description: Items where the fine-tuned answer lost a check.

app_home.title: App Home
app_home.description: Where FlipTuned keeps its data (read-only here).

allowed_roots.title: Allowed Roots
allowed_roots.description: Folders the app may browse and read data from (uploads are always allowed).

idle_timeout_min.title: Idle Timeout Min
idle_timeout_min.description: Minutes without a chat message before the model is released.

upload_max_mb.title: Upload Max Mb
upload_max_mb.description: Largest file that can be uploaded, in MB.

dev_mode.title: Dev Mode
dev_mode.description: Show developer options, such as tiny test-only models.

port.title: Port
port.description: Port `fliptuned serve` tries first (the next free one if it's taken); used from the next launch. `--port` overrides it.

recorded.title: Recorded
recorded.description: Judgements stored, by A / B / tie.

blank.title: Blank
blank.description: Rows with an empty judgement (not reviewed yet).

mapping_complete.title: Mapping Complete
mapping_complete.description: Both question and answer columns were recognized.

auto_error.title: Auto Error
auto_error.description: Why 'auto' finds nothing, if it doesn't.

max_epochs.title: Max Epochs
max_epochs.description: Most passes over the training data. Training may stop earlier if validation stops improving.

patience.title: Patience
patience.description: Stop after this many validation checks in a row without improvement.

batch_size.title: Batch Size
batch_size.description: Examples processed together. Higher uses more memory.

grad_accumulation_steps.title: Grad Accumulation Steps
grad_accumulation_steps.description: Batches combined before each update. Raises the effective batch size without extra memory.

learning_rate.title: Learning Rate
learning_rate.description: How big each update step is. Too high can make training unstable.

max_seq_length.title: Max Seq Length
max_seq_length.description: Longest example in tokens. Must match the dataset build.

eval_every_steps.title: Eval Every Steps
eval_every_steps.description: Check validation loss (and save a checkpoint) every this many weight updates.

gradient_checkpointing.title: Gradient Checkpointing
gradient_checkpointing.description: Save memory at the cost of roughly 20% slower training.

mlx.description: Settings used only on Apple Silicon (MLX).

hf_peft.description: Settings used only on NVIDIA GPUs and CPU (Transformers + PEFT).

folder.title: Folder
folder.description: Upload folder of this source (scan and ingest it).

ok.title: Ok
ok.description: True when no check failed (warnings allowed).
